message.content: {"issues":[{"number":27,"field":"context formatting","problem":"The transcription omits the visible underlining of the marked expressions associated with ㉠ ‘둥싯’, ㉡ ‘저런’, ㉢ ‘치르르치르르’, and ㉣ ‘오물오물’ in the source."},{"number":27,"field":"context annotation","problem":"The source’s [C] bracket visibly spans both the ear-ringing anecdote and the subsequent snoring anecdote through “나는 그런 적 없소이다!”, whereas the transcription places [C] only after the first anecdote and does not preserve that span."}],"checked_numbers":[27]}
